items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived pushforward is compatible with composition of morphisms of ringed topoi (statement lines 4010-4021). The proof chooses a K-injective representative so that the derived pushforwards are computed by the naive ones (proof lines 4023-4026) and applies the composition identity for naive pushforwards, which is licensed by the stability of K-injectivity under direct images (proof lines 4026-4030). The non-formal content is the choice of representatives. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one identity.
